answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can be grounded in proof-of-personhood attestations anchored to a verifiable credential graph, so a hollow identity lacking real stake cannot propagate trust across peers. Each agent must bond capital into a shared dune-like registry whose incremental proofs are checked by consensus, and only then may it mint a lotus credential binding. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
